messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Paging eng-oncall — elevated error rate detected for tenant 'orchid' in dedicated VPC 'orchid-prod-vpc'. Tool/function-call failures (parser errors) started ~09:12 UTC. 502/500 spikes and JSON parse failures in our toolcall layer. Auto-created incident: INC-2026-1784.
Alex W: seeing this now, I'm grabbing recent logs. can someone post a sample failing payload?
Priya K: fyi this looks correlated with last night's runtime patch (compiler+json-parser update rolled 02:30 UTC). Could be schema/decoder change.
Diego M: sample from logs (09:14:07):
```
ERROR toolcall: Failed to parse tool response for request=orchid-req-7f3c
ParserError: Unexpected token '\uFFFD' at position 12
json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes: line 1 column 3 (char 2)
raw_tool_resp: '\uFFFDstatus: OK, data: {id: 123, value: \"x\"}'
```
Alex W: that raw_tool_resp looks like mixed encoding + missing quoting. could be model decoder change that emits bare keys sometimes.
Priya K: confirm: only Orchid VPC affected? infra-bot, can you confirm isolation?
infra-bot: Confirmed — failures scoped to `orchid-prod-vpc` (nodepool id np-orchid-2). Nearby tenants on same cluster show <0.1% failures. Current failing request rate for Orchid: 18% of toolcall traffic (09:12-09:28 window). Total failed calls ~1.2k in window.
Maya (Orchid): We're getting lots of 502s from our customers. Any ETA on a fix? Our support queue is filling.
Jess (Incident Commander): taking incident. priority P1 for customer impact. Objectives: 1) stop customer-facing errors 2) identify root cause (parser/regression) 3) decide rollback vs. hotfix.
Sam L: immediate mitigations we should consider: 1) route Orchid toolcall traffic to fallback model variant (known v1-compatible) 2) disable auto-json-parse on the tool pipeline for Orchid so we pass raw text to their parser 3) short-term increase retry/backoff to reduce user errors.
Diego M: I can push routing change. command I will run (dry-run first):
```
rictl route update --tenant orchid --route toolcall --fallback redwood-v1-compat --reason "parser regression mitigation" --dry-run
rictl route update --tenant orchid --route toolcall --fallback redwood-v1-compat --reason "parser regression mitigation"
```
Priya K: I can patch config to disable auto parse for the tenant: `service.configs.tool_parser.auto_parse["tenant:orchid"] = false` — applying via control plane. Exec will be: `rictl config set --tenant orchid tool_parser.auto_parse false`
Alex W: also let's snapshot a few failed bodies for postmortem. Diego, capture 50 samples and upload to secure incident bucket.
Diego M: grabbing samples now. uploading to s3://incidents/orchid/1798765432/samples.tar.gz
infra-bot: Routing change applied (dry-run ok). Applying fallback now.
oncall-bot: Runbook step: if fallback reduces errors below 5% within 15m, mark as mitigated. Otherwise escalate to rollback of runtime.
(09:34 UTC) infra-bot: Fallback route to `redwood-v1-compat` applied for tenant=orchid.
Alex W: monitoring traces... initial sign: error rate dropped from 18% -> 6% over first 3 minutes. good sign.
Maya (Orchid): thank you — we see error rate dropping on our side too. still some failures for older sessions.
Priya K: applied auto-parse=false for Orchid. command output: `OK — config updated (propagating to 3 orchestrators)`
Sam L: rolling retries increased to 3 with 250ms base backoff for Orchid in the control plane.
Diego M: uploaded sample bundle and annotated the ones showing non-JSON keys. link: https://redwood-internal/incident/1798765432/samples (access-controlled).
Jess (Incident Commander): current status: mitigated -> customer traffic routed to v1-compat fallback + auto-parse disabled. Error rate down to 3% (09:40 UTC). Impact: ~1.3k failed calls total, ~0.8% of tenant monthly traffic. SLA at risk but not breached yet.
Alex W: root cause hypothesis: runtime patch introduced a change that emits non-escaped keys for some tool formats (loose-key object dumps). When auto-json-parse is enabled we try parse and crash. We'll need a regression test + revert/patch.
Priya K: next steps: 1) create PR to revert parser change in runtime and add strict JSON conformance test, 2) coordinate with release to push 2.4.0 rollback if tests confirm, 3) schedule a customer postmortem with Orchid CS.
Maya (Orchid): appreciate the quick routing fix. we'll keep support updated. please share follow-up timeline.
Jess (Incident Commander): assigned action owners: Diego = samples & artifact collection, Alex = reproduce + unit test, Priya = config rollback PR, Sam = follow-up with CS + SLA calc. ETA for RCA draft: 48 hours.
(10:05 UTC) infra-bot: Partial rollback attempted on one nodepool (np-orchid-2a) -> runtime 2.4.0, results mixed (50% success). Holding full rollback until tests pass.
Sam L: we'll keep the fallback in place for now. I'll do the customer update at 10:20 UTC.
Jess (Incident Commander): handing off to night oncall (Sam L) at 11:00 UTC. Incident remains open for RCA and release decision. If anyone sees a regression in mitigation (error rate >7%), page me.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-1784 status=mitigated->open_followup. Incident channel pinned.
Alex W: noted — grabbing a few more trace samples and will start a minimal repro harness against 2.4.1 vs 2.4.0.
Priya K: prepping rollback PR draft now. will include hotfix and test.
Maya (Orchid): thanks again. we'll coordinate a postmortem meeting after RCA.
Jess (Incident Commander): thanks team. good triage and quick mitigation. follow-ups in #incidents and ticket INC-2026-1784.
(11:00 UTC) Sam L: night oncall ack and will monitor until handback.
